tagline: You can now control serverless network traffic between Databricks workspaces.
what_it_does: You can now control serverless network traffic between Databricks workspaces. Account admins use cross workspace access to set which source workspaces can reach a workspace (ingress) and which destination workspaces a workspace's serverless workloads can send traffic to (egress). Traffic flows only when both the source workspace's egress rules and the destination workspace's ingress rules permit it.
why_it_matters: It does not govern classic compute traffic.
